checked: OSU Kappler text: Convention with the Creeks, Nov. 14, 1805, 7 Stat. 96, proclaimed June 2, 1806; Article 1 Oconee-Ocmulgee cession with the 5 by 3 mile Ocmulgee fields tract reserved; Article 2 horse path to Mobile; Article 3 $12,000 a year for eight years and $11,000 for ten more. Matches.

ICC Docket 292 findings of fact (OSU id 64) quote Article 3 of this treaty and state the obligation as $96,000 plus $110,000; disbursements definitely allocated to this treaty $169,452.25; the defendant admits an obligation of $206,000. The opinion (OSU id 113) sets out this claim and the claims 'under the Treaties of 1805 and 1832'; the final order (OSU id 409, Feb. 18, 1959) dismisses all claims. So Docket 292 does cover this treaty, contrary to the file.
Inter-Tribal Council resolution kept as nationVoice; status no-breach-found unchanged (dismissal is a ruling against the nation).
